The complete plan is maintained in [`18-day-foundation-model-plan.md`](../18-day-foundation-model-plan.md). It starts with Transformer fundamentals, builds a full foundation-model systems map, and then specializes in post-training and reinforcement learning.

## Daily cadence

| Block | Time |
|---|---:|
| History and theory | 60 min |
| Mathematics | 45 min |
| Colab implementation | 120 min |
| Ablation and visualization | 45 min |
| Flagship essay chapter | 30 min |

## Weekly outputs

1. **Inside a Modern LLM: From Tokens to KV Cache**
2. **How Foundation Models Are Built and Extended Beyond Text**
3. **Post-Training from First Principles: SFT, RLHF, DPO and GRPO**
